reason: A common-feature experiment was not run. The available source files do not define a fully comparable behavioral predictor set across all three questionnaires. Google Forms age group uses readable age bands and social_media_buying contains age in years (these two can be aligned), but the psychological workbook uses numeric AGEGRP codes with no codebook. BUYFREQ is also an undocumented category code, while the social dataset's online_purchase_frequency is a count with no stated time window; the survey uses verbal frequency categories. Retail channel, social platform, and coded psychological PLATFORM are not interchangeable. Survey discount level, perceived_discount, and the psychological questionnaire do not have a documented common scale. Mapping any of these across all three sources would add unsupported assumptions. The extended-feature experiment retains valid source specific measures with missing values for other sources and uses training-fold imputation. This estimates performance on a mixture of these datasets, not guaranteed cross-source generalization.
